_doc: Curated 6-case suite for the 4-way backend benchmark (ke graphrag bench). Cases are drawn verbatim from graphrag_eval.json and chosen to differentiate mini / lazy / ms / agentic: a figure-disambiguation case, a tabular date lookup, a broad text/stat case, a multi-hop comparison, a relationship-bridging case (favours graph/agentic), and an adversarial out-of-scope case (tests refusal). Keep this small — running 4 backends with ms/agentic is slow.
